column1: # USD per 1M tokens. Columns: model, input, output, cache_read, cache_write, label.
# label is the provider:model name stored in the Jira field "Agent models" (a model with no row gets provider:<raw id>).
# Input, output and cache_read are list prices (claude-api skill table, 2026-11-03). cache_write is assumed to be
# 1.25 x input, and haiku-5-5 cache_read is assumed (0.05 x input); check both against the pricing page.
# OpenAI rows: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, Standard tier, short context (<=272K input tokens),
# checked 2026-11-15; cache_write is the 30m write price. Context above 272K input tokens in one request is billed at
# the Long rate, which this table does not model. codex-auto-review (the Codex guardian child agent) is not on that
# page, so it has no row and counts 0 until OpenAI lists a price.
# A model missing here is reported as unpriced and counts 0 toward the cost.
